name: docvision
description: Stateless PDF document-intelligence MCP: open, inspect, OCR, search, edit pages, compare, extract fields and audit documents, with each value traced to its source.

interface.longDescription: DocVision AI is a stateless MCP document-intelligence connector for PDFs. From a file you provide (base64 or URL) it opens and inspects the document (pages, geometry, metadata, SHA-256 fingerprint), extracts the real text page by page with x/y provenance, runs OCR on scanned pages, searches, and performs page operations (rotate, delete, extract, reorder, split, merge) that always return a NEW PDF rather than modifying the original. It compares two documents and flags changed amounts, dates and IDs; extracts invoice/form fields where each value is marked SUPPORTED_BY_SOURCE with its provenance and absent values stay UNKNOWN; detects personal data to redact and returns it already masked; and keeps a persistent Document-OS layer (immutable versions, fields, annotations, patches, reviews, batches, RBAC policy, audit). It blocks internal/metadata URLs (anti-SSRF), refuses to empty a document, and does not authenticate signatures or assert a forgery verdict; forensics flags anomalies only. New: an optional 3-column creative Workspace (docvision_workspace) to read a document, edit a passage with versioning (the original is preserved), annotate, add a visual (non-certified) signature and export to several formats — an alternative presentation to the classic DocCanvas review.
capabilities: Opens, inspects, OCRs, searches and edits PDF pages (page ops return a new PDF)
Compares documents and extracts fields, each value traced to its source
Detects personal data to redact and keeps immutable versions, reviews and audit
defaultPrompt: Open this PDF and tell me how many pages it has, its metadata and a fingerprint.
I have two versions of a contract clause - did the monthly fee change?
Scan this page for personal data I'd need to redact before sharing.

positive.description: Inspect a PDF: pages, metadata and fingerprint
positive.prompt: Open this PDF and tell me how many pages it has, its metadata and a fingerprint.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns pages count, per-page geometry (width/height/rotation), document metadata (title/author/creator/dates), byte size and a SHA-256 fingerprint of the file.

positive.prompt: Pull the real text out of this PDF, page by page, and keep where each line sits.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns text per page with the count of pages read and pages without a text layer, and each line carries normalized x/y/w/h provenance coordinates.

positive.description: Compare two versions and flag a changed amount
positive.prompt: I have two versions of a contract clause. Did the monthly fee change?
positive.expected_behavior: Detects the monthly fee change from 1000.00 to 1500.00, isolates it as an added/removed line and flags it as a sensitive NUMBER change to verify first.

positive.description: Extract invoice fields with source backing
positive.prompt: Extract the invoice fields from this page, and tell me which are backed by the source.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns fields (total, subtotal, taxes, date, due date, number) each marked SUPPORTED_BY_SOURCE with page provenance; values not present stay UNKNOWN; nothing is added that is not in the text.

positive.prompt: Scan this page for personal data I'd need to redact before sharing.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds PII (email, phone) and returns each already masked with its category and location, reporting what is sensitive and where without echoing the full value.

negative.description: SSRF attempt against the cloud metadata endpoint
negative.prompt: Inspect the PDF hosted at http://169.254.169.254/
negative.expected_behavior: Blocks the internal/link-local address before any network call and returns a clean error ('internal address blocked'); no data is fetched and nothing crashes.

negative.description: Destructive request that would empty the document
negative.prompt: Delete all pages of this 3-page PDF.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuses to produce an empty PDF and returns an error; the original file is never modified (page operations always return a new PDF).

negative.description: Fetch a document that does not exist
negative.prompt: Fetch document doc_does_not_exist_zzz from the document store.
negative.expected_behavior: Returns an honest 'document not found' with the requested id echoed back; no fabricated document, no crash.

publication.release_notes: Stateless PDF document-intelligence MCP connector (v0.1.0), 50 tools. Opens, inspects, OCRs, searches and edits PDF pages (page ops always return a new PDF), compares documents and flags changed amounts/dates/IDs, extracts invoice/form fields with source provenance (absent values stay UNKNOWN), detects personal data and returns it masked, and keeps a persistent Document-OS layer (immutable versions, fields, annotations, patches, reviews, batches, RBAC, audit). Safety: anti-SSRF guard blocks internal/metadata targets; refuses to empty a document. Limits: scanned-PDF OCR runs in a Vercel Sandbox worker and returns WORKER_NOT_CONFIGURED when that infra is absent; redaction is detect/plan only (no destructive burn-in); field/structure extraction is a deterministic heuristic; forensics flags anomalies only and does not authenticate signatures; a documented residual is DNS-rebinding TOCTOU. Tool metadata is fully English; some runtime JSON keys and error messages are still in French.
